salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). SeVerus (formal-verification benchmark of quests and levels; Codex agent with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna; one experiment also with Claude Code and Sonnet 4.6). GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna columns of Table II (RQ1: highest solved level, tau_b on solved attempts, cost in USD: 6 projects + total), Table III (RQ2 over ten quests per project: Root, Mean, RLS, Attempts, Cost: 6 projects + All), Table IV (re-stated recall and Jaccard of the deleted lemmas, GPT-6 Sol only, per project and All) and Table V (how failed attempts end and why the agent stops: counts for S = GPT-6 Sol and L = GPT-6 Luna). '*' in Table II marks a significant success decrease (kept in the notes). Budget 5 USD per attempt and a 4-hour limit; network restricted to the model API (web search disabled). The measured entry is the Codex agent (harness) with the model; effort not written (no mention of a reasoning effort found); costs in USD per project over its attempts (Table II) or over the ten quests (Table III).
agent: convertisseur k-openai-2 (Sonnet 5.5), lecture ligne par ligne du fichier de recherche et de la copie
